fov.subtitle: Find the field size of your own microscope, convert counts to and from mm², and see how many fields each protocol requires you to count.
fov.setupHint: Enter the eyepiece field number (printed on the eyepiece, e.g. "10x/22") or a diameter measured with a stage micrometer. The setting is saved in this browser.
fov.tubeFactorHint: Leave at 1× unless the stand has a magnification changer or intermediate lens.
fov.measuredHint: Measure the diameter of the field on a 1 mm stage micrometer scale. Other objectives are derived from it.
fov.invalid: Enter positive values to calculate the fields.
fov.formula: Diameter = field number ÷ (objective × tube factor); area = π·(d/2)². Field counts are rounded to the nearest whole number, as in the CAP and WHO tables; the exact value is in brackets.
fov.convHint: Turn a count in N fields of your microscope into a density per mm² — and back.
fov.convEmpty: Enter the count and the number of fields.
fov.summary: {{count}} mitoses in {{fields}} fields at {{objective}}× (field Ø {{diameter}} mm, {{fieldArea}} mm²; total area {{area}} mm²) = {{perMm2}} mitoses/mm² ({{per2}} per 2 mm²).
fov.refHint: Older criteria are written as "per 10 HPF" of a specific diameter. This converts your density into that convention.
fov.refResult: Your count corresponds to {{value}} per 10 fields of Ø {{diameter}} mm ({{area}} mm²).
fov.reverseTitle: From a threshold to your microscope
fov.reverseHint: Given a criterion per mm² (or per 2, 5, 10 mm²), how many figures that means in the fields you counted above.
fov.reverseResult: {{value}} per {{unit}} mm² = {{count}} figures in {{fields}} fields at {{objective}}×.
fov.reqTitle: How many fields to count, by entity
fov.reqHint: Areas, denominators and cut-offs as printed in the CAP protocols and WHO 5th edition; the number of fields is computed for your microscope.
fov.reqFields: Count {{fields}} fields at {{objective}}× ({{exact}} exact) to cover {{area}} mm² — actual area {{covered}} mm².
fov.reqDivide: Divide the total by {{divisor}} to report per {{unit}} mm².
fov.reqLegacy: Historical reference — {{label}}: equals {{fields}} fields at {{objective}}× ({{exact}} exact).
fov.reqUndefined: The source does not define the field size, so no safe conversion to mm² exists. Record your field diameter when reporting.
fov.breastScore: Your field (Ø {{diameter}} mm, {{area}} mm²): score 1 ≤ {{s1}}; score 2 = {{s2from}}–{{s2to}}; score 3 ≥ {{s3}} mitoses per 10 fields.
fov.breastClamped: Your diameter ({{diameter}} mm) is outside the 0.40–0.69 mm range of the CAP table; the nearest row was used — confirm before grading.
fov.disclaimer: Support tool for the reporting pathologist. Check the protocol in force before grading; field counts are rounded as in the CAP/WHO tables. Reference: Cree IA et al., Counting mitoses: SI(ze) matters! Mod Pathol 2021;34:1651–1657.

prostate.subtitle: Map the cassettes of a radical prostatectomy, enter tumour and patterns per cassette and get volume, weighted Gleason (ISUP 2014/2019), margins, extraprostatic extension and a suggested stage — with the specimen mapped in 2D and 3D.
prostate.disclaimer: Decision-support tool. Grading follows the ISUP 2014/2019 rules for prostatectomy (a lower-grade minor pattern ≤ 5% is ignored; a higher-grade pattern ≤ 5% is reported as tertiary). Volume is the mean tumour % per cassette and assumes cassettes of similar size. Staging is a suggestion: check the current AJCC/CAP criteria before signing out.

setup.title: 1 · Cassette grid
setup.hint: Describe how the specimen was sectioned: transverse slices from apex to base, sectors per slice and apex/base cones (parasagittal cuts, right to left).
setup.coneHint: 0 = no separate cone (apex/base are the first and last slices).
setup.bySlice: By slice (slice 1: AD, AE, PD, PE; slice 2…)
setup.bySector: By sector (all slices of AD, then PD, AE, PE; cones last)
setup.saveTemplate: Save the current grid as a template

globals.title: 2 · Case parameters
globals.hint: How percentages were recorded, plus findings that do not belong to a single cassette.

globals.cribPerCassetteHint: 'Crib.' column in the table: % of that cassette's pattern 4 that is cribriform.
globals.idcPerCassetteHint: Tick the 'IDC' column in the cassettes with intraductal carcinoma.
globals.adjacentInvasion: Invasion of adjacent structures (rectum, bladder, sphincter, pelvic wall) — pT4

table.title: 3 · Findings per cassette

table.hintOfCassette: Tumour, G4 and G5 = % of the cassette area (the rest of the tumour is pattern 3). Enter jumps to the next field.
